Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIV OF 2000
ORDINANCE XIV OF 2000
Sindh Irrigation
(Amendment) Ordinance 2000.
An Ordinance to amend
the Sindh‑Irrigation Act, 1879
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th November
2000]
No. S. Legis: 1(14)/2000, dated
15‑11‑2000.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh
Irrigation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force on
and from Kharif, 2000.

Amendment of sections 61 and 62 of Act VII of 1879

ORDINANCE XIV OF 2000
ORDINANCE XIV OF 2000
Sindh Irrigation
(Amendment) Ordinance 2000.
An Ordinance to amend
the Sindh‑Irrigation Act, 1879
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th November
2000]
No. S. Legis: 1(14)/2000, dated
15‑11‑2000.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑‑
2. Amendment of sections 61
and 62 of Act VII of 1879.‑‑In the Sindh Irrigation Act, 1879,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 61, for the words
"three months", the words "two years" and for the words
"one thousand rupees", the words "ten thousand rupees"
shall be substituted.

Amendment of sections 61

section 62, for the words "one year", the words "three
years" and for the words "two thousand rupees"; the words

section shall be inserted.
"62‑B.Non‑bailable
offence.‑‑An offence punishable under section 61 or 62
shall be non‑bailable.".
